meta.name: grounding
meta.description: Establish what is actually true and current for the surface you are about to change — not just search. Grounding = locate the authoritative source and reconcile sources that disagree (code vs doc, migration vs schema, memory vs current code, live vs archived), not take the first hit. Use before any grep/find/explore of the codebase or docs, when deciding which of several definitions is the real one, or when a doc or memory conflicts with the code. Covers the source-of-truth hierarchy, reconciliation discipline, scoped ripgrep, and the docs/tags.yml + docsearch.py index.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在修改前找到并核对权威信息源
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要在多个信息源间确认什么是当前真实状态。
copy.tagline_en: Find and verify the authoritative source before making changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to reconcile conflicting sources to determine what is actually true.

howto.what: Claude 会先找出最权威的信息源，并对比代码、文档、记忆等不同来源，解决矛盾后再行动，而不是直接采用第一个搜索结果。
howto.when: 在修改代码或文档前，当多个来源（如代码与文档、记忆与当前代码）存在冲突时触发。

say.text: 检查这个函数的定义，代码和文档哪个是对的？
say.note: Claude 会对比代码和文档，找出权威来源。

say.text: 确认数据库迁移文件中的 schema 是否最新。
say.note: Claude 会查看迁移文件，并与当前 schema 对比。

howto.what_en: Claude first identifies the authoritative source and reconciles conflicts between code, docs, memory, etc., before acting, rather than taking the first search hit.
howto.when_en: Triggered before modifying code or docs, when multiple sources (e.g., code vs doc, memory vs current code) disagree.

say_en.text: Check the function definition; which is correct, code or doc?
say_en.note: Claude compares code and doc to find the authoritative source.

say_en.text: Verify if the DB migration schema is up-to-date.
say_en.note: Claude checks migration files and compares with current schema.
